title: Getting the Most Out of This Course 🚀

blocks.content: Getting the Most Out of This Course 🚀
You'll get the most value from this course if you treat it like a real project, not something to rush through.

items: Take a moment to study the design before coding.
Try things, even when you're not 100 percent sure.
Expect to tweak and adjust your code.
Compare what you built with what you see.

blocks.content: Frontend progress can feel invisible day to day. But every layout decision, every spacing fix, every cleanup compounds. By the end, you'll feel that difference clearly.
Next, let's start building the HTML.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
